constructions.title: Counts of held files, as the drafts quote them

stations_series.total_station_months.is: Station-months in the monthly station panel: the sum of `n` over every variable in `docs/data/areas/stations_series.json`. One station-month is one monthly median of one variable at one station, so a station with nine variables in a month counts nine times.

stations_series.n_stations.is: Stations listed in the panel's `stations` array - positions, not water bodies.

stations_series.months.is: Monthly slots the panel declares, counted from its first year.

stations_series.bin_bytes.is: Size of `stations_series.bin` in bytes, as read.

stations_series.variables.*.n.is: Station-months carrying this variable: the `n` the panel declares for it.

stations_series.variables.*.stations.is: Distinct stations among this variable's station-months, read from the station indices in the binary at the variable's offset.

oda_portal.*.no_period.is: Stations the ODA portal's criterion list returned for this topic with no period set - the current network - as recorded by hand in `data/manual/data_sources_2.json` (`ODA-STATION-COUNTS-CORRECTION`).

oda_portal.*.with_period.is: Stations the same list returned with the period set to the whole record, as recorded by hand in the same register entry.

maaledybde.rows.is: Records the Python `csv` reader returns from `data/raw/oda/maaledybde.csv.gz`, header excluded - one record is one sounding at one station on one date.

maaledybde.stations_with_bottom_depth.is: Distinct stations with at least one non-blank `BundDybde_m`.

maaledybde.rows_x_equals_x1.is: Records whose `X_UTM32` and `X_UTM321` are the same string - the northing column the extract lacks.

seabed.classes.is: Distinct values of the substrate field `sedimenten`.

seabed.by_class.*.is: Polygons carrying this `sedimenten` value - polygons, not area.

seabed.by_scale.*.is: Polygons compiled at this map scale (`scale` field).

seabed.campaigns.is: Distinct values of the `mapping` field, which names the survey campaign each polygon was compiled from.

mfs.by_type.*.is: Points whose `eusurfacew` code starts with this letter prefix (lake or river water body).

mfs.biota.is: Points whose `maaltbiota` flag is set (not blank, zero or no).

mfs.no_matrix.is: Points with none of the three matrix flags set.

mfs.distinct_qecode.is: Distinct values of `qecode` across the points.

mfs.distinct_qestatusor.is: Distinct values of `qestatusor` across the points.

mfs.distinct_da_oekolog.is: Distinct values of `da_oekolog` across the points.

mfs.distinct_aktivstart.is: Distinct values of `aktivstart` across the points.

plankton.n_files.is: Yearly files of the CMEMS Baltic phytoplankton grid on disk: every `plankton__inner__YYYY.nc` under `data/raw/cmems/grid`, one per year, a partial year included.

plankton.n_variables.is: Data variables in the newest of those files - everything that is not a dimension - read with netCDF4 in the marine environment.

constructions.what: Counts the monthly station panel, the soundings extract, the seabed sediment layer and the pollutant-status layer, and parses the station counts the ODA portal returned as recorded in the source register - the file facts the hypothesis drafts and open problems cite.
constructions.model: Plain counts over the files as held: sums of the panel's declared `n`, distinct station indices read from its binary, distinct values and group counts over the soundings CSV and the two geographic layers, and a pattern match over the register's recorded portal counts.
assumptions: The files on disk are the extracts the drafts describe.
The portal counts in the register were read correctly when they were recorded.

justified.text: Every count is taken by the script from the file itself, so it follows the file when the file changes.
The panel's layout - station indices, then month indices, then values, at each variable's offset - is read as the panel declares it.
The soundings extract is read with the declared ODA format: semicolon delimiter and `latin-1`.

gaps: The portal counts are a hand record of a web form in `data/manual/data_sources_2.json`; this script parses them but cannot re-run the query, so they are only as current as that record.
A matrix flag counts as set unless it is blank, zero or no; the layer documents no other coding.
void_if: an extract is re-fetched and this script is not re-run
the portal's station lists change after the register entry was recorded
constructions.licenses: Statements about the files as held: how many records, stations, polygons or points they contain and how those divide.
constructions.not_licensed: Anything about the water, the seabed or pollutants themselves; any count of what exists outside the extracts; any claim that the portal still returns these station lists today.
